essentials: I usually wear European size 39.

Do you have one size larger?

lines.text: What size do you usually wear?

lines.speaker: partner

lines.speaker: partner

lines.speaker: you

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Of course. Take your time.

conversations.title: Checking peanut allergy safety before ordering
essentials: I have a severe peanut allergy.
I cannot eat even a small amount.
Does this dish contain peanuts?
Do you use cooking utensils that have touched peanuts?
If you cannot confirm, I will not eat this dish.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Excuse me, I have a severe peanut allergy.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Which dish would you like?

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: This dish. Could you check the ingredients?

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: I will check with the kitchen.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: I cannot eat even a small amount. Do you use cooking utensils that have touched peanuts?

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: We use shared cooking utensils, so I cannot confirm that there is no contact with peanuts.

lines.speaker: you
lines.text: Then I will not eat this dish. Thank you for checking.

lines.speaker: partner
lines.text: Understood. I will not place the order.
